crossRefs.note: For who has stood in the council of Yahweh, that he should perceive and hear his word? Who has listened to my word, and…
You shall speak my words to them, whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse; for they are most rebellious.
“Son of man, I have made you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and warn them…
for I didn’t shrink from declaring to you the whole counsel of God.
saying, “Return now everyone from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that Yahweh has…
I have sent also to you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, ‘Every one of you must…
It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the evil which I intend to do to them; that they may each return from…
Because with lies you have grieved the heart of the righteous, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of…
“Therefore I will judge you, house of Israel, everyone according to his ways,” says the Lord Yahweh. “Return, and turn…
Don’t you be like your fathers, to whom the former prophets proclaimed, saying: Yahweh of Armies says, ‘Return now from…
to open their eyes, that they may turn from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God, that they may receive…
For they themselves report concerning us what kind of a reception we had from you, and how you turned to God from…
and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead: Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.
so then let’s not sleep, as the rest do, but let’s watch and be sober.

translations.web: But if they had stood in my council, then they would have caused my people to hear my words, and would have turned them from their evil way, and from the evil of their doings.
translations.bsb: But if they had stood in My council, they would have proclaimed My words to My people and turned them back from their evil ways and deeds.”
translations.kjv: But if they had stood in my counsel, and had caused my people to hear my words, then they should have turned them from their evil way, and from the evil of their doings.
translations.asv: But if they had stood in my council, then had they caused my people to hear my words, and had turned them from their evil way, and from the evil of their doings.
